bio_en: Khachatur Gevorgian was born in 1872 in Sheikh-Yaghub in Bulanikh and at fourteen left to work abroad, reaching Tiflis in 1886 with emigrants from his region. Brought home by his father to farm, he witnessed the suffering of his people and in 1893 left plough and family for Tiflis, where he joined the ARF. In 1905, during the Armenian-Tatar clashes, he worked with the Batum Central Committee, and from 1907 organised self-defence groups in Salmast. He died in an accident in May 1908 caused by a scoundrel condemned by the party.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Also called Kheco/Khepo in the text; not to be confused with Dashnaktsakan Khecho (Khachatur Amirian).
